# Vendored Dependencies

These files are vendored so the GUI builds without downloading anything at configure time.

| File | Project | License |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `raygui.h` | [raysan5/raygui](https://github.com/raysan5/raygui) | zlib/libpng |
| `stb_image.h` | [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) | MIT or public domain |
| `tinyfiledialogs.c`, `tinyfiledialogs.h` | [native-toolkit/tinyfiledialogs](https://github.com/native-toolkit/tinyfiledialogs) | zlib |
| `cJSON.c`, `cJSON.h` | [DaveGamble/cJSON](https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON) | MIT |

Keep the upstream license notices when updating these files.
